name: The Lists VR
detailed_description:
Mount your horse, lower your lance, and experience the thrill of medieval jousting in full virtual reality.

The Lists VR puts you directly on the tournament field in 15th-century Europe. Compete in a focused, skill-based jousting experience where your body becomes the controller. Every pass down the list, every impact, every point scored — it all happens with your hands, your timing, and your presence.

Built for VR

  • Tilt, aim, and brace as you wield your lance entirely through natural motion

  • Feel the pressure of the charge through timing, positioning, and physical presence

  • Designed to immerse you fully — from the weight of the lance to the tension before impact

Dynamic Scoring System

  • Points awarded for targeted strikes to shield, body, and visor

  • Points are shown by flags raised in the grandstand — no floating numbers or HUD clutter

A Living Tournament Environment

  • Set in 1410 Salzburg, with the looming Fortress Hohensalzburg overlooking the field

  • Surrounded by tournament tents, noble spectators, heraldic banners, and ceremonial detail

  • Designed to evoke the feeling of real-world historical tournaments, recreated with a focus on immersion and atmosphere

If you’ve ever wanted to know what it would feel like to tilt down a medieval jousting lane, to physically lean into the charge, to shatter a lance, to win the crowd, The Lists VR lets you step into that moment.

Three passes. One opponent. Ride when ready.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-7600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (6GB VRAM minimum)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR (Oculus Rift, Meta Quest via Link, Valve Index) — Requires motion controllers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT or better
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR (Oculus Rift, Meta Quest via Link, Valve Index) — Requires motion controllers.
